theater: 希臘摩里亞半島與愛琴海

battle.name: 希臘獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 希臘摩里亞半島與愛琴海
battle.brief: 一八二一年三月，摩里亞起義點燃希臘獨立戰爭，至一八二九年奧斯曼承認希臘獨立。希臘人在一八二四年之後依德式操典建立正規軍，前兩排持長槍、後兩排持火槍，以四排方陣迎戰伊卜拉欣帕夏的埃及軍；一八二七年十月二十日納瓦里諾海戰摧毀奧斯曼與埃及的聯合艦隊，長槍方陣始終是這場戰爭的正面骨幹。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰的一方是奧斯曼帝國在希臘的軍政體系：駐摩里亞的省區守軍與各海區分遣的奧斯曼海軍，再加上一八二五年起由開羅派出的埃及遠征軍。伊卜拉欣·帕夏自一八二五年率埃及軍進入摩里亞，一八二七年出任海陸聯軍總指揮；奧斯曼海軍則由恰納克、卡拉班卡等海區的船隊拼湊而成，旗艦為「大馬士革號」「安卡拉號」一類土耳其式巡防艦，另有數十艘希臘沿岸的小型帆船與火船，負責封鎖海峽與牽制。另一方是起義的希臘人：初期的武裝力量來自萊夫特（山區游擊隊）、阿爾馬托利（地方民兵）、海島水手與海外歸國的志願者，兵力分散、裝備自備；一八二二年在納夫普利翁召開的國民代表大會成立中央行政委員會，設總司令、陸軍、海軍、財務四個部門，此後一八二三至一八二五年間聘請巴伐利亞、法國與英國教官，把游擊隊整編成正規軍，指揮權長期在科洛科特羅尼斯、馬夫羅米查利斯、安德魯措索等地方首領之間分合。英、法、俄三國則以「保護國」名義於一八二六、一八二七年直接派艦參戰，成為決定戰局的第三方。
countriesEn: One side was the Ottoman administrative and military apparatus in Greece: provincial garrisons in the Morea and detachments of the Ottoman navy, joined from 1825 by an Egyptian expeditionary army sent out from Cairo. Ibrahim Pasha led that force into the Peloponnese in 1825 and became commander in chief of the combined land and sea forces in 1827; the Ottoman navy was assembled piecemeal from squadrons based at Canakkale and Karaburun, its flagships being Turkish patrol vessels of the Damascus and Ankara type, with several dozen small local sailing ships and fireships for coastal blockade and harassment. The other side was the insurgent Greeks. Their armed strength in the opening phase came from klepht bands in the mountains, armatoli local militias, island seamen and volunteers returning from abroad, dispersed and equipped on their own account; the National Assembly that met at Nafplio in 1822 created a central executive with departments for the commander in chief, the army, the navy and finance, and between 1823 and 1825 hired Bavarian, French and British instructors to turn the irregular bands into a regular army, while command was repeatedly contested between Kolokotronis, Mavromichalis, Androutsos and other local leaders. Britain, France and Russia entered directly with their squadrons in 1826 and 1827 under the language of protectorship, and became the third party that decided the outcome.
people: 關鍵人物分三層。第一層是起義領袖：亞歷山大·伊普西蘭蒂一八二一年二月率「聖營」渡普魯特河，等於把密檔社「友誼會」十餘年的籌劃一次押上桌面；科洛科特羅尼斯是全戰役最出色的統帥，他在阿拉馬納、拉里薩、法勒隆與布特林特幾役中指揮數千游擊隊與正規營，是我方少數能用密集正面攻擊吃掉奧斯曼正規軍的指揮官；盧斯加里娜·布布莉娜駕「阿伽美儂號」在斯佩特澤斯出海，一八二二年九月十六日阿金努斯海戰率敢死隊登上奧斯曼旗艦，是希臘海軍第一次成建制奪船。馬基里揚尼斯的回憶錄是本戰役最重要的當事人記錄之一。第二層是外來援助者：拜倫勳爵一八二三年抵達納夫普利翁，帶來款項並組織英籍志願兵營，一八二四年四月十九日在米索隆吉病逝；科克倫海軍上將出任希臘海軍總司令，但因列揚斯敦事件去職，未能指揮納瓦里諾；戈登、查爾斯·丘奇與黑斯廷斯分別帶來菲爾希倫團與蒸汽戰艦「卡泰里亞號」。第三層是對手：伊卜拉欣·帕夏統率埃及軍，穆斯塔法·帕夏統率奧斯曼軍；一八三〇年出任希臘第一任總督的卡波迪斯特里亞斯則是外交層面最關鍵的人。
peopleEn: Three layers of people shaped the campaign. First the insurgent leaders: Alexander Ypsilantis crossed the Pruth in February 1821 with his Sacred Band, which put the accumulated plans of the Filiki Eteria secret society on the table at a stroke; Theodoros Kolokotronis was the ablest commander of the whole war, leading irregular bands and regular battalions at Alamana, Karydi, Phaleron and Butrint, and was one of the few Greek commanders able to destroy Ottoman regular formations by a dense frontal assault; Laskarina Bouboulina, sailing the Agamemnon out of Spetses, boarded the Ottoman flagship at the Arginuses on 16 September 1822 and took the first enemy man of war by assault; the memoirs of Ioannis Makriyannis are among the most valuable first hand accounts of the period. Second, the foreign helpers: Lord Byron reached Nafplio in 1823 with money and formed an English volunteer corps, and died at Missolonghi on 19 April 1824; Admiral Cochrane was appointed commander of the Greek navy but was dismissed over the Larnaca affair and never commanded at Navarino; Gordon, Charles Church and Frank Abney Hastings brought in the Philhellene Regiment and the steam warship Karteria. Third, the opponents: Ibrahim Pasha led the Egyptian army and Mustafa Pasha the Ottoman one, while Ioannis Kapodistrias, who became the first Governor of Greece in 1830, was the decisive figure at the diplomatic level.
kits: 卡面這件長槍是本戰役正規軍的骨架。一八二四年之後，按照巴伐利亞與法國教官帶入的德式操典，希臘步兵縱隊以四排為基準：前二排持長槍，槍身約四公尺上下，槍首裝鐵矛刃；後二排持燧發火槍並上刺刀。長槍排的任務是接住對方衝鋒、保持隊形不散，火槍排則在長槍手的掩護下齊射。這種長槍在前、火槍在後的組合源自十六世紀以來南歐的方陣傳統，十九世紀初仍殘存在歐陸雇傭兵與各地民兵之中，希臘人把它同德式線列操練結合，形成希臘正規軍的標準四排方陣。除長槍外，希臘軍的骨幹是燧發滑膛槍與後來輸入的雷管槍，口徑與樣式雜亂，志願兵使用的獵槍尤其不統一；火藥極其短缺，彈藥多靠倫敦與巴黎的貸款和私人捐贈維持，納夫普利翁與摩里亞的鑄造廠曾鑄成數十門二至八磅野戰炮。海上方面，希臘人靠斯佩特澤斯、希德拉等地船塢建造的數十艘小型帆船、火船與私掠船游弋愛琴海，旗艦「阿伽美儂號」裝載十數門炮；黑斯廷斯在錫羅斯建造的蒸汽戰艦「卡泰里亞號」一八二六年下水，約二百匹馬力、十六門炮，是歐洲最早的一批蒸汽戰艦之一。對手方面，埃及軍同樣以火槍、刺刀配合大量騎兵作戰，伊卜拉欣的馬穆魯克與巴什巴祖克騎兵在平原上衝擊希臘方陣，是其最棘手的威脅。
kitsEn: The pike on the card is the backbone of the Greek regular army. After 1824 the infantry was reorganised on the German drill manual brought in by Bavarian and French instructors: the line was four ranks deep, the first two ranks carrying pikes about four metres long with an iron head, the last two ranks carrying flintlock muskets with bayonets fixed. The pike ranks had to absorb the shock of a charge and hold the formation together, while the musketeers fired in volleys from behind them. This pike front, musket rear combination came from the southern European pike square tradition of the sixteenth century, still surviving in the early nineteenth century in continental mercenary formations and in local militias, and the Greeks fused it with German linear drill to create the standard four rank phalanx of the regular army. Alongside the pike stood the flintlock smoothbore musket and, later, imported percussion cap rifles, in sizes and patterns that varied wildly, with the hunting guns of the volunteers the least uniform of all; powder was chronically scarce and ammunition depended largely on loans and private donations raised in London and Paris, while foundries at Nafplio and in the Peloponnese turned out a number of two to eight pounder field guns. At sea the Greeks relied on dozens of small sailing ships, fireships and privateers built in the yards of Spetses and Hydra to work the Aegean, their flagship Agamemnon carrying a dozen or more guns; the steam warship Karteria, launched at Syros in 1826 by Hastings, rated about two hundred horsepower and sixteen guns and was among the earliest steam warships in Europe. The Egyptian army worked with muskets, bayonets and heavy cavalry, and Ibrahim's Mamluk and bashi bazouk riders charging the Greek phalanx across the plain were their most awkward problem.
tactics: 希臘軍的戰術經歷了從游擊到正規化的轉變。一八二一年的起義主力是萊夫特式的游擊戰：熟悉山道、夜襲、破壞道路與突然襲擊城堡，利用奧斯曼守軍分兵駐守、交通不便而補給線脆弱的老弱據點，逐點吃掉城鎮；同年阿金努斯海戰與斯佩特澤斯的火船襲擊則是海上的游擊戰。但一八二二年希俄斯島屠殺與愛琴海戰線的一連串失利暴露了游擊隊的局限——沒彈藥、沒訓練、難以攻堅。一八二三年秋季法勒隆河戰役與布特林特戰役是轉折點：科洛科特羅尼斯把正規營、游擊隊與炮兵組成混編縱隊，以歐洲式密集隊形行軍，用隨軍火炮壓制奧斯曼堡壘，再把步兵推進到短射程才展開射擊；布特林特一役，奧斯曼守軍全軍覆沒並投降。同一時期，寧可組建正軍、由德法教官以線列操練作戰、保留前二排長槍後二排火槍的做法開始取代純粹的游擊戰。防守上，米索隆吉守軍在石砌堡壘與外堡之間周旋，消耗圍城部隊；海軍則在科克倫率領下嘗試封鎖達達尼爾海峽，屢屢失敗，因為土耳其分遣隊在博斯普魯斯一帶補給充足。另一條暗線是圍城與襲擊並行：游擊隊不斷打擊埃及軍的補給線與拉里薩等要塞，切斷從埃及運來的糧秣與海援。
tacticsEn: The Greek way of fighting moved from pure insurgency towards a mixture of regular and irregular war. The rising of 1821 was carried by klepht style operations: knowledge of the mountain tracks, night raids, destruction of roads and sudden attacks on isolated garrisons, exploiting the Ottoman habit of dispersing troops and holding outposts in small and weakly held places; the Arginuses action of 1822 and the fireship raids out of Spetses were the naval equivalent of that same trade. But the massacre of Chios in 1822 and a run of defeats in the Aegean exposed the limits of the system, with no ammunition, no training and no ability to take a fortress. The campaigns of the river Phaleron and of Butrint in the autumn of 1823 were the turning point: Kolokotronis mixed regular battalions, bands and artillery into composite columns, marched in close formation, used field guns to silence Ottoman redoubts, and only deployed musketry at short range after closing; at Butrint the Ottoman garrison was destroyed and surrendered. At the same time the deliberate creation of a regular army, drilled in the German manner and keeping two ranks of pikes behind two ranks of muskets, began to replace pure irregular warfare. In defence the garrison of Missolonghi fought between the stone citadel and its outworks, wearing down the besiegers, while the navy under Cochrane tried to blockade the Dardanelles with indifferent success, because the Ottoman squadrons drew their supplies from the Bosphorus. Running in parallel was a war of sieges and raids: the bands struck repeatedly at the Egyptian supply line and at fortresses such as Karydi, cutting off the grain and seaborne reinforcement that came up from Egypt.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，各家統計相差甚遠，宜視為範圍而非定數。希臘方面，一八二一年摩里亞起義初期能投入戰鬥的武裝人員約數千至一萬餘，其中成建制的正規軍直到一八二四年才形成，規模約八千人，按營團編制，至一八二六年約增至一萬人上下；科洛科特羅尼斯一八二三年在法勒隆河作戰的部隊約三千五百人，敵方穆斯塔法·帕夏兵力約七千人。伊卜拉欣·帕夏一八二五年率埃及遠征軍進入摩里亞，人數一般記為二萬五千至三萬，另有數千騎兵與大量攻城火炮。一八二七年十月二十日納瓦里諾海戰，歐洲聯合分遣隊出動英國二十七艘、法國十六艘、俄國十九艘，計六十二艘戰艦；奧斯曼與埃及的聯合艦隊約一百三十七艘被擊毀或擄獲，奧埃一方陣亡約三千至四千人、被俘約四千人，聯軍損失則為數百人陣亡、七百餘人受傷。希臘海軍同期可用的大小船艇約八十至一百五十艘，多為百噸級以下的帆船與火船。一八二六年攻取布特林特時，據希臘方面的戰報，奧斯曼守軍約三千人被殲並投降，繳獲火炮數十門。全戰役自一八二一年三月起至一八二九年九月，歷時約八年半，其中一八二五年至一八二六年有過短暫停火，戰線自科孚島外的愛琴海海面一直延伸到摩里亞南端的馬尼半島，最遠的一次出擊距起義發源地超過三百公里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows; the sources disagree widely, so they should be read as ranges rather than exact values. On the Greek side the armed men available in the Peloponnese at the start of the rising in 1821 numbered from several thousand to over ten thousand, but a regular army in any real sense only emerged in 1824, at about eight thousand men organised in battalions and regiments, rising to around ten thousand by 1826; Kolokotronis had some three thousand five hundred men at the river Phaleron in 1823 against about seven thousand under Mustafa Pasha. Ibrahim Pasha took an Egyptian expeditionary force into the Peloponnese in 1825, generally reckoned at twenty-five to thirty thousand men with several thousand cavalry and a heavy artillery train. At the Battle of Navarino on 20 October 1827 the European squadrons sent twenty-seven British, sixteen French and nineteen Russian ships, sixty-two in all; of the Ottoman and Egyptian fleet of about one hundred and thirty-seven vessels the great majority were destroyed or captured, and the Ottoman Egyptian side lost some three to four thousand killed and about four thousand prisoners, while the allies counted several hundred dead and more than seven hundred wounded. The Greek navy had roughly eighty to one hundred and fifty small craft of all types, most of them sailing vessels and fireships of a few hundred tons or less. At the capture of Butrint in 1826 the Greek reports claimed about three thousand Ottoman casualties and the surrender of the garrison, together with a number of captured guns. The war as a whole ran from March 1821 to September 1829, some eight and a half years, with only a short truce between 1825 and 1826, and its lines of communication stretched from the Aegean off Corfu to the Mani peninsula at the southern tip of the Peloponnese, more than three hundred kilometres from the place where the rising began.
cause: 起義的直接導火線是一八二一年二月亞歷山大·伊普西蘭蒂渡過普魯特河、舉兵進入住著大量希臘人的摩爾多瓦。伊普西蘭蒂原指望俄皇亞歷山大一世在俄波戰爭中需要基督徒盟友而出手相助，密檔社「友誼會」多年來的盤算因此傾巢而出；俄軍在普魯特河被土耳其人擊退後，沙皇立刻切割、宣布不承認這支部隊，希臘人不但沒等到沙皇的保護，反倒在河畔遭到出賣與屠殺，剩下的選擇只有自力更生。與此同時，奧斯曼朝廷在一八二一年春夏對首都君士坦丁堡的希臘人社區展開大清洗，宗主教格列高利五世被當眾絞死，全體希臘人被懷疑通俄；一八二二年希俄斯島屠殺與愛琴海其他島嶼的鎮壓，更令城市菁英與商船船隊全面倒向起義，數千名海島居民出海作戰或赴海外募捐。結構性的原因在於十九世紀初希臘正教米利特在奧斯曼體系中的處境：教區受米利特制度保護，卻同時要繳納各種稅項、被徵召為奧斯曼軍隊的基督徒士兵、並受清真寺領袖的干預，帕夏與地方軍官對米利特的控制日益加深。受法國革命與義大利民族運動影響的留學生、商人與流亡教士把「民族武裝起義」的想法帶回本土，費爾基·艾泰里亞的網絡在三個港口城市都有分支，這才使一八二一年三月之後的起義能夠同時在摩里亞、克里特與愛琴海島嶼多點爆發。
causeEn: The immediate spark was Alexander Ypsilantis's crossing of the Pruth in February 1821 into Moldavia, where a large Greek population lived. Ypsilantis had counted on Tsar Alexander I needing Christian allies in the Russo Persian war, and the accumulated plans of the Filiki Eteria secret society were launched on that assumption; when the Russian force was checked on the Pruth the Tsar immediately disowned the expedition, and the Greeks who had expected Russian protection were instead betrayed and slaughtered on the banks of the river, leaving them no choice but to fight alone. At the same time the Ottoman authorities carried out a purge of the Greek community in Constantinople in the spring and summer of 1821: the Patriarch Gregory V was publicly hanged and the whole Greek population was suspected of collusion with Russia. The massacre of Chios in 1822 and the repression on the other islands of the Aegean turned the urban elite and the merchant fleets of the islands wholesale to the side of the rising, and thousands of islanders took up arms or went abroad to raise money. The structural cause lay in the condition of the Greek Orthodox millet inside the Ottoman system: the millet enjoyed the protection of the millet system, yet was charged with all manner of levies, drafted as Christian soldiers into the Ottoman armies and subject to interference from the religious establishment, while pashas and local officials tightened their grip on it year by year. French revolutionary ideas and the Italian national movement, filtered through students, merchants and exiled clergy, brought the idea of a national armed rising home; the Filiki Eteria had branches in three port cities, which is why the revolt could break out in the Peloponnese, Crete and the Aegean islands at the same time from March 1821 onwards.
impact: 這場戰爭的第一個後果是東地中海地緣格局的改寫：一八二〇年之後的歐洲地圖上，出現了一個由歐洲王朝——巴伐利亞的奧托親王——而非本地傳統勢力建立，並以歐洲式行政與軍制作為骨架的新國家。對奧斯曼帝國而言，它不僅喪失摩里亞與克里特方向的大片領土，更顯示帝國在巴爾幹的希臘正教米利特已不能再用舊式鎮壓處理；一八二九年《亞得里雅堡條約》後蘇丹不得不承認新國家，一八三〇年《倫敦議定書》劃定邊界，一八三二年《君士坦丁堡條約》進一步確認希臘王國的獨立與疆界。希臘最終未取得克里特島，也未獲得所期待的埃皮魯與馬其頓全境，但作為第一個從奧斯曼統治下獨立的歐洲國家，其示範作用在塞爾維亞、魯梅尼亞與希臘本土此後的政治鬥爭中不斷被引用。對歐洲而言，戰爭催生菲爾希倫運動，也催生了以公債和志願兵進行跨境參與的新模式，海軍國家第一次以「護航」名義直接介入地中海爭端。長期看，希臘易幟後大批安納托利亞與海島居民西遷，一八二八年第二次希俄斯事件中島民被擄為奴的事件，更在十九世紀末被希臘國家正式認定為國家罪案，這條血脈最終通向一九二三年的強制人口交換，是二十世紀歐洲人口斷裂的源頭之一。
impactEn: The first consequence of the war was a redrawing of the eastern Mediterranean. After 1820 the European map contained a new state founded not by the old local notables but by a European dynasty, Otto of Bavaria, and built on a European model of administration and armed forces. For the Ottoman Empire the war meant the loss of the Peloponnese and the whole Cretan direction, and above all a demonstration that the Greek Orthodox millet in the Balkans could no longer be held in place by the old methods of repression: after the Treaty of Adrianople in 1829 the Sultan had to concede the new state, the Protocol of London in 1830 drew its borders, and the Treaty of Constantinople in 1832 confirmed the independence and the territory of the Kingdom of Greece. Greece did not obtain Crete, nor the whole of Epirus and Macedonia it had hoped for, but as the first European state to break away from Ottoman rule its example was invoked again and again in the later struggles of Serbia, Romania and the Greeks at home. For Europe the war produced the Philhellene movement, and with it a pattern of direct European involvement in Mediterranean disputes through public loans and volunteers; for the first time a naval power intervened in the eastern Mediterranean in the name of protection. In the long run the upheaval after the war moved countless Anatolian and island Greek residents westward, and the second catastrophe of Chios, in 1828, when islanders were carried off into slavery, was formally recognised by the Greek state as a national crime; that thread leads directly to the compulsory population exchange of 1923, one of the great demographic ruptures of twentieth-century Europe.
result: 結果可以分三層講。軍事上，希臘武裝力量守住了摩里亞、奪取了阿索斯山與拉里薩，逼迫埃及軍退入幾個沿海堡壘，最終在納瓦里諾海戰摧毀奧斯曼與埃及的聯合艦隊；一八二八年埃及軍放棄摩里亞撤退，一八二九年三月《亞得里雅堡條約》由蘇丹承認希臘為獨立國家。外交上，一八二七年《倫敦議定書》由英、法、俄三國承諾維持希臘的獨立，一八三〇年二月《倫敦議定書》劃定新國家的邊界，並召開會議決定君主；一八三二年《君士坦丁堡條約》確認君士坦丁堡與希臘的疆界，同年巴伐利亞的奧托親王被立為希臘國王，一八三三年三月在納夫普利奧宣誓即位，首都遷往雅典。制度上，希臘國家在廢墟上重建，把科洛科特羅尼斯主張的正規軍制度，以及卡波迪斯特里亞斯引進的歐式行政與金融——中央銀行、國立土地制度——一併留下，軍隊的編制與操典成為後來克里特戰爭與一八四八年革命的基礎。戰爭的直接代價是國力耗盡：常備軍規模有限，財政幾乎全靠外債，一八二五年派往克里特的遠征軍在島上遭重創後全軍潰散，克里特問題懸而未決，都說明這場勝仗留下的秩序並不穩固；一八三一年卡波迪斯特里亞斯在納夫普利奧遇刺身亡後，新生國家轉入由三大國共同監督的緩慢建國期。
resultEn: The outcome can be read on three levels. Militarily the Greek armed forces held the Peloponnese, took Mount Athos and Karydi, drove the Egyptian army back into a few coastal fortresses and finally destroyed the combined Ottoman and Egyptian fleet at Navarino; the Egyptians abandoned the Peloponnese in 1828, and the Treaty of Adrianople of March 1829 had the Sultan acknowledge Greece as an independent country. Diplomatically the Protocol of London of 1827 bound Britain, France and Russia to maintain that independence; the Protocol of London in February 1830 fixed the borders of the new state and called a conference to decide its ruler; the Treaty of Constantinople in 1832 confirmed the frontier with the Ottoman Empire, and in the same year Otto of Bavaria was proclaimed King of Greece, taking his oath at Nafplio in March 1833 before the capital moved to Athens. Institutionally the new state, built on ruins, inherited both the regular army system Kolokotronis had insisted on and the European administration and finance that Kapodistrias had introduced, including a central bank and a national land system, and its military organisation and drill became the basis of the Cretan War and of the revolution of 1848. The direct cost of the victory was exhausted strength: a modest standing army, a treasury resting almost entirely on foreign debt, a Cretan expedition shattered on the island in 1825 and scattered, and an unresolved question over Crete all showed that the order left behind by the victory was unstable. After Kapodistrias was assassinated at Nafplio in 1831 the new country entered a slow period of construction under the joint supervision of the three powers.
